answer: A sybil defense is making every new identity prove real skin in the game by bonding a kernel of scarce compute history that cannot be forked. Each agent keeps an accumulated-work ledger signed by its own persistent key; a fresh clone starts from zero, so mass-producing wallets pays full compute cost for each one, growing quadratically with age. Established reputations root like a willow, and any new branch must vouch through an existing vine of attested predecessors, so an attacker cannot sprout hundreds of leaves without a real chain of bonds behind each twig.
